name: Milky PopUp
author: abhishekbandhu

sections.description:
Milky PopUp is a popup builder for WordPress. Create popups without writing a single line of code. Whether you want to grow your email list, announce a sale, or stop abandoning visitors, Milky PopUp has you covered.

Our visual builder works directly inside your WordPress dashboard, giving you a real-time preview of exactly how your popup will look to your visitors.

Source Code: The React source code used to generate the admin interface is bundled within this plugin in the /react-app/ directory.

Features

  • Live Visual Builder: Design your popups with real-time feedback.
  • Pre-built Triggers: Show popups on page load, after a delay, or when a user clicks a button.
  • Custom Forms: Collect names and emails seamlessly.
  • Subscribers Dashboard: View and manage your leads directly inside WordPress.
  • Mobile Responsive: All popups are automatically optimized for mobile devices.
  • Lightweight: Built with modern React and vanilla JS to ensure your website stays incredibly fast.

Premium Features (Pro Version)

Need more power? Upgrade to Milky PopUp Pro for advanced features:
* Advanced Triggers: Exit-intent technology to capture abandoning visitors.
* Custom Form Fields: Collect phone numbers, dates of birth, countries, and custom messages.
* Design Upgrades: Custom background blur, overlays, and typography controls.
* 1-Click Export: Export all your collected leads to a CSV file instantly.
* Agency Management: Unlimited sites and priority support.

Privacy

Milky PopUp is designed with privacy in mind. By default, the plugin stores the following data locally on your WordPress server:
* Analytics Data: When a visitor views, dismisses, or interacts with a popup, we log the event. To protect privacy and assist with GDPR compliance, visitor IP addresses are irreversibly hashed before storage. We do not store raw IP addresses for analytics. We also record the visitor’s traffic source (e.g., ‘Google Search’), device type (e.g., ‘mobile’), and the page URL they were viewing.
* Lead Data: When a visitor submits a form through a popup, we store the information they explicitly provide (such as their Name and Email Address). We also store an irreversibly hashed version of their IP address for security and rate-limiting purposes (to prevent spam).
* Data Sharing: Milky PopUp does NOT send your leads, analytics, or visitor data to any external servers. All data remains securely in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the milky-popup folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. A new ‘Milky’ menu will appear in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Click ‘Milky’ and start building your first popup!
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my website?

No! Milky PopUp is built to be extremely lightweight. The frontend loads less than 10kb of JavaScript and CSS.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. The visual builder lets you customize colors, text, images, and form fields with just a few clicks.

Where do my leads go?

Your leads are saved directly to your WordPress database. You can view them by going to Milky -> Subscribers.

  • Added ‘Powered by Milky’ watermark toggle.

  • Initial release.
